AI Quiz Assistant

Enable automated AI-powered quiz solving using your own free Google Gemini API key.

100% Free Option

How to get a Free Google Gemini API Key:

  1. Go to Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com).
  2. Sign in with your Google account and click Create API Key.
  3. Copy and paste your key below. Google offers a generous free tier (no credit card required).
Your API key is stored locally in your browser and is only sent directly to Google's API endpoint.
